text: 3 weekly sessions appears to be warranted. Very high training frequencies (6 days per week) do not appear to be more effective than moderately high frequencies (3 days per week) for enhancing hypertrophy, although limited evidence precludes the ability to draw strong inferences on the topic. Although both total-body and split routines can be viable training strategies, dividing workouts by body region (e.g., upper and lower, pushing and pulling) may be more effective when training with higher volumes because it allows higher weekly frequencies (and thus shorter sessions) while affording greater muscular recuperation between workouts.
